about_the_game:
Embark on the journey of cultivating immortality and immerse yourself in the endless fun of treasure hunting and nurturing!

Easy AFK, Get Endless Treasure;

Multiple career options - sword cultivator, body cultivator, spirit sorcerer, beast tamer, each showcasing their divine abilities!

Awaken extraordinary physical constitution, such as the ancient holy body, the innate holy body, and the Dao fetus, standing tall among the heroes.

From quenching body to Mahayana, break through the fairyland and embark on your supreme immortal journey!

explain:

The store page images are temporary screenshots, and the game content and gameplay are currently under development. Many new content and materials will be added to optimize the game, and improvements will also be made based on previous player reviews.

This new game series is not a completely new game, but an upgrade and reconstruction of the previous generation of games.

This game is an independent game, and the author's abilities, energy, and funds are limited. The new game is not for shell swapping to make money:

1. We need funding to support research and development, and we cannot spend many years polishing it to perfection before releasing it.

2. The new game will invest a lot of time and effort in refactoring, enriching content, and increasing gameplay. Although not all of them may bring positive reviews, the author's intention is definitely to make the game better.

3. Although the mainstream gameplay of the new game has not changed much on the surface, the internal logic and data structure have been restructured. This restructuring is destructive to the game's data archives. If you have to constantly iterate on a game, you really don't have the energy to repair the player's data archives frequently. What's more, frequent modifications can bring a bad experience to players.

4. The author is not a professional in the gaming industry, and game development is just a hobby with insufficient experience, resulting in flaws in all aspects of the game. However, the author hopes to continuously refine and create an interesting game that brings joy to players.

5. Regarding price: The new version uses bundled packages to encourage old players to purchase at a lower price. The total price of the bundled package will only be slightly higher than the unit price of the new game.

6. Thank you to the old players, because of your support, the game can continue to develop and iterate.

7. Welcome everyone to give a<real>review of the game. Positive reviews are the driving force, while negative reviews can make the game progress.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: i3-9100F
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A cultivation treasure-hunting game with AFK mode. Pick from Sword Cultivator, Spiritual Sorcerer, or Beast Tamer. Unlock the Ancient Holy Body. Advance from Body Tempering to Mahayana, up to Immortal Realm. Capture spirit beasts as allies.
supported_languages:
English*, Traditional Chinese*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
